---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose a new feature, page, or function.
title: 'feat: [Brief description of the feature]'
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Overview
Provide a clear and concise description of the new feature. What problem does it solve, etc.

## User Story
Fill in this sentence:
As a [type of user, such as a student visitor or committee member], I want to [perform some action] so that I can [achieve some benefit].

## Requirements
Describe the outcomes. What must this feature achieve? (Focus on the required results, not how they should be coded).

## Implementation Notes
List any suggestions, technical approaches, or design ideas on how to build this. (Optional tips for the developer but not restricted to using them).

## Interface and Layout Details
- Does this require a new route or page? [Yes/No, list path if Yes]
- Are there mockups or wireframes available? [Link or upload them here]
- Are there specific responsiveness requirements for mobile or tablet screens?

## CMS Requirements (if applicable)
Does this feature require new content fields or schemas in Sanity? If so, describe the fields needed (such as Title, Publication Date, etc.).

## Acceptance Criteria
What must be true for this task to be considered complete?
- [ ] Criteria 1
- [ ] Criteria 2
- [ ] Criteria 3
